limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: assessed by the panel and lead; needs a global optimisation over generators
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: beyond publication scope; effect sizes stated

limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can the range be extended to s < -n/2 or s > 1?
